transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm explaining this right, but... well, honestly, what made me finally make an appointment is just some little things at work. I'm in advertising sales, and we have these really, really long strategy meetings. 

And I just... I keep getting up when I know I’m supposed to stay seated. Like, I’ll make up little reasons to leave my chair, even if it’s just to go refill my water for the third time, or I'll kind
Did you have trouble sitting still as a child?

Um, well, I guess so? I mean, I was a good kid, I promise. But I do remember this starting way back, like, way before high school. In elementary school, my teachers would always write on my report cards that I was... well, they always made sure to say I was a bright student! Which was really nice of them. 

But, um, they'd also say I rushed through my work a little bit. And maybe talked out of turn sometimes? I feel a little silly admitting this, but they also mentioned I'd forget my homework, and my desk was always just kind of... stuffed with half-finished papers. I think I was just really eager and enthusiastic to move on to the next thing, you know? Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you spend a lot of your day worrying about things, even when there isn’t an immediate problem?

Um, worrying? Not really, no. I mean, I care about my job and doing well, of course, but I wouldn't say I sit around worrying about things that aren't happening. I try to stay pretty positive! I'm more of an upbeat person, I think. I don't really get stuck in my head with anxious thoughts or anything like that. I hope that's okay? I just... I don't think worrying is really one of my struggles.
